Name: Rapha, Son of Binea
Summary: Son of Binea and father of Eleasah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:37; 1 Chronicles 9:43: Son of Binea and father of Eleasah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Rapha stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
